channel.title: Electronic components: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New filings from Korean small and mid-cap companies in the electronic components sector.

item.title: HanWool Materials Science: Hanul Materials Science signed a KRW 1.91bn contract to supply gadolinium oxide powder to KEPCO Nuclear Fuel, equal to 14.25% of revenue.
Sejin T.S: Sejin T.S filed a court petition to suspend the Korea Exchange's 23 September 2026 delisting decision and block liquidation trading.
Samyung ENC: Samyung ENC's largest shareholder changed to Five Ocean Co., Ltd., which holds 75.27% after a third-party rights offering under its rehabilitation plan.
Automobile & PCB: Automobile & PCB applied to Seoul Southern District Court to suspend its delisting decision and administrative issue designations by Korea Exchange.
Samyung ENC: Samyoung ENC amended its rights-offering report, correcting pre-increase shares outstanding to 6,569,366 from 6,569,206 after reverse-split fractional share handling.
Samyung ENC: Samyoung E&C amended its capital reduction filing, revising share counts and post-reduction capital after fractional share treatment; the reduction ratio is 75%.
HanWool Materials Science: Hanul Materials Science signed a KRW 3.56bn contract with KT for the 2026 Public Safety LTE network PTN build-out.
Ryuk-il C&S: Yukil CNS completed its KRW 25.0bn acquisition of land and building in Songdo, Incheon, from Onhill after final payment on 10 November 2026.
